name: Riya S.
title: Mum asked what it means
body: Wore it to Sunday lunch. Mum asked what it means, dad laughed into his chai. The print is thick and hasn't cracked after ten washes.

name: Arjun M.
title: Heavy in the best way
body: The 240 GSM is real. The oversized fit sits right on the shoulders. One star off only because I wanted it a day earlier.

name: Kabir T.
title: Office Friday approved
body: Soft-censored enough for office Friday, loud enough for the metro. Size L is roomy, so size down if you like it closer.

name: Neha P.
title: Quiet flex
body: The monogram is subtle and the black hasn't faded. Looks far more expensive than it is.

name: Dev R.
title: Clean and boxy
body: Great boxy cut and the collar holds its shape. I'd love a sand colourway.

name: Ananya K.
title: Chai ke saath
body: Bought two: one for me, one for my chai-obsessed flatmate. The sand colour looks lovely in daylight.

name: Ishaan V.
title: Wore it to a sangeet
body: Log kya kahenge? Log kept asking where I bought it. The red is deep and the print is crisp.

name: Meera J.
title: Runs big
body: Lovely tee, but the oversized fit really is oversized. I swapped M for S and the exchange was painless.

name: Rohan D.
title: For the friend who is always leaving
body: Gifted it to the friend who is always 'just leaving'. He wears it with zero irony. Perfect.

name: Sana A.
title: A shirt that gets a smile
body: The Oxford cloth is crisp and the chest print is small and neat. Works with chinos for a smart-casual Friday.

name: Vikram N.
title: Proper shirt quality
body: Buttons are sturdy and the stitching is even. Sleeves are a touch long for me.

name: Tara G.
title: Traffic jam energy
body: Every time a cow blocks my scooty I think of this tee. The print is sharp and the white stays white.

name: Pooja L.
title: Pink City pride
body: The rose shade matches the old city walls. The crop is flattering and not too short.

name: Lalremsiami C.
title: Finally
body: Great to see the Northeast on a tee that isn't a cliché. The teal is gorgeous.

name: Karan B.
title: Conversation starter
body: Strangers read it out loud at the café. The fabric is thick and the print feels soft, not plasticky.

name: Aditi R.
title: Birthday gift sorted
body: Bought it for my brother's birthday and he wore it the same night. Neat packaging too.

name: Siddharth P.
title: Good tee
body: slow shipping
tags: Love the design and the fabric. Delivery took six days to Nagpur, inside the promised window, but I was impatient.

name: Harpreet K.
title: Sounds like home
body: The Punjabi line made my nani laugh. Proper everyday slang, not the film version.

name: Aparna M.
title: Nice to see Malayalam
body: The script is printed cleanly, no broken letters. I'd love more colours in the regional range.

name: Nikhil S.
title: Smart enough for work
body: The print is small enough for the office and funny enough for after. Linen breathes well in humid weather.

name: Farah Q.
title: Keep an iron handy
body: Beautiful shirt. Poplin creases easily, so keep an iron handy.

name: Zoya H.
title: Type nerd approved
body: Letter spacing and weight are properly considered. This is design, not just words on a tee.

name: Manish Y.
title: My nephew won't take it off
body: Survived mud, paint and a monsoon puddle. Still looks new.

name: Shreya D.
title: Fits like the size guide says
body: I measured a tee I own against the size guide and it matched to the centimetre. Rare.

name: Aman J.
title: Fast delivery
body: Ordered on Monday, arrived on Thursday, with tracking updates the whole way.

name: Priya V.
title: Washes well
body: Five washes in: no shrinking and the print is intact. Wash it inside out like the tag says.

name: Rahul K.
title: Gift for the whole group
body: Got different tees for my college group. Everyone found their personality in the catalogue.

name: Divya N.
title: Easy exchange
body: The size was off, so I raised an exchange and the new one arrived in four days. No questions asked.

name: Imran S.
title: Warm enough for spring evenings
body: The heavyweight cotton is great for cool evenings. It's my layering piece now.

name: Sneha B.
title: Colour is lighter than on screen
body: The mint is a bit lighter than the picture. Still nice, just set your expectations.

name: Varun T.
title: Quality you can feel
body: The collar rib is thick, the side seams are straight and there are no loose threads.
